# Trinetry Infotech

> Trinetry Infotech is a DPIIT-recognised AI engineering firm building at the intersection of artificial intelligence, quantitative research, and software engineering — 12 production products shipped across crypto, fintech, AI, edtech and enterprise on a startup budget.

## Key facts
- Type: AI engineering / quantitative research firm (product + advisory)
- Audience: startups and enterprises needing AI/ML, quant systems, data infrastructure, or product engineering
- Live: https://trinetryinfotech.com
- Recognition: DPIIT-recognised
- Track record: 12 products shipped, 17 blockchains, 1,000+ coins, 130+ TA indicators, 10+ ML models
- Flagship: CryptoPrism on-chain analytics platform (live at app.cryptoprism.io)
- Team: 3-person core, capital-efficient, globally deployed
- Engagement: advisory, fractional engineering lead, project delivery
- Contact: yogesh.sahu@trinetryinfotech.com
